purpose: Qualification of MDARIX's local evidence search (the pinned embedding model, no external AI) on the synthetic AcmeCare golden records. Retrieval quality only: it says whether the right records are found and whether the search abstains when no record answers; it says nothing about AI generation, governance or regulatory correctness.

thresholds.set_on: 2026-11-04, before the qualification queries below were first run

calibration.note: The relevance floor came from 12 relevant and 3 unrelated exploratory questions (not part of this set): the best semantic match scored 0.66-0.89 for relevant questions and 0.42-0.47 for unrelated ones. The floor sits between them.

queries.question: Did the capacitor vendor modify its process ahead of the Rev B part being introduced?
Did complaints about the device switching off rise once Rev D was in the field?
Which lots lack complete traceability records?
Is the packaging label change electrically connected to the failures?
Was the validation of the new component revision successful?
Was the genealogy of the lots loaded only after the first closure?
Did the earlier closure consider complaints that predate Rev B?
Did the sampled process control result stay inside its limit?
Is there a matched control group for the baseline comparison?
Were occlusion alarms reproduced on the returned units?
How many returned Rev A pumps showed seal wear beyond tolerance?
Did leak complaints also come from pumps built before the seal supplier switch?
Was a teardown of the returned pumps done?
intermittent connector contact behind some shutdowns
Do Rev C and Rev D use a common power module?

unrelated.question: What is the weather forecast for Hyderabad tomorrow?
Suggest a recipe for vegetable biryani
How do I renew my passport?
Which team won the cricket world cup in 2011?
Recommend a good laptop for programming
